prova:
have h₁ : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by norm_num
have h₂ : ∀ n : ℕ, (Hypergraph.blockSizeProfiles n).card ≥ 1 := by
  intro n
  exact Finset.card_pos.mpr (Finset.mem_univ ())
exact ⟨1, h₁, fun n => by
  have : 0 < (Hypergraph.blockSizeProfiles n).card := by
    simpa using h₂ n
  have : (1 : ℝ) < (Hypergraph.blockSizeProfiles n).card := by
    simpa using this
  have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (Hypergraph.blockSizeProfiles n).card := by
    linarith
  have : Real.exp (1 * Real.sqrt n * Real.log n) ≤ (1 : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith [Real.exp_le_exp (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt n * Real.log n ≤ 0)]
  nlinarith [Real.exp_le_exp (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt n * Real.log n ≤ 0)]⟩
